brand_identity.name: Adroit Management and Tax Consultants

brand_identity.aesthetic: Established Chartered Accountancy and elite corporate financial consultancy. Navy Blue deep authority, brushed bullion gold luxury accents, and crisp architectural negative space.

rules.gradient_overload_ban: No generic rainbow or loud tech gradients. Pure solid deep navy (#10243A), subtle tinted slate grey backgrounds (#F3F6F9), and crisp 1px gold borders (#C6A15B).
rules.transparent_header_ban: Never allow transparent headers over content. Use glassmorphic solid backdrop 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#10243A]/95 text-white border-b border-[#C6A15B]/20' or 'bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md text-[#10243A] border-b border-slate-200'.
rules.buttons: Primary CTA uses Gold #C6A15B background with dark Navy #10243A or white text, with hover darkening to #B38F48. Secondary CTA uses Navy border or outline with subtle gold icon.

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#10243A] text-white border-b border-[#C6A15B]/30 shadow-md
header.top_bar: Deep Navy top strip with Noida contact number, email 'info@adroitconsultants.in', WhatsApp quick link, and Client Portal/Admin access button.
header.main_nav: Adroit Emblem with Gold crest, 'Adroit Management & Tax Consultants' wordmark, links: Home, About Us, Our Services (with mega dropdown/category shortcuts), Our Team, Contact Us, and Gold pill button 'Schedule Consultation' [data-testid='header-schedule-btn'].

footer.style: bg-[#0B1828] text-white pt-20 pb-12 border-t-2 border-[#C6A15B]

Right: Floating prestige metrics card (18+ Years Experience, 2500+ Audits & Tax Filings, 99.4% Regulatory Compliance, 4 Associated CA Practices).

home_page.services_grid_10: Tetris/Bento style 10 service cards grid with custom Lucide icon, Gold accent line, service code, brief description, and 'Explore Details' button.

home_page.consultation_cta_strip: Navy background container with gold border: 'Let's Discuss Your Business Requirements' + instant booking button.

services_page_and_accordion.multi_select_accordion: Interactive accordion of 10 service categories with sub-services. Each category and sub-service has a high-contrast checkbox [data-testid='service-checkbox-*'].

contact_us.rule: Strictly NO MAP. Use crisp office address cards, sector coordinates, metro landmark hints (Sector 62 Noida Hub), email, direct phone lines, and action buttons: Call Now, WhatsApp Now, Schedule Consultation.
contact_us.form: Fields: Full Name, Entity/Company Name, Email, Phone Number, Service of Interest (Dropdown), Subject, Detailed Requirement message, Submit button.

schedule_consultation.features: Dedicated booking engine with interactive Date Picker, Time Slot selector (Morning 10-12, Afternoon 2-5, Evening 5-7), Consultation Mode (In-Person at Noida Office vs. Virtual Video Conference), Business Category, and Instant Confirmation summary.

admin_dashboard.access: Secure authentication state (mocked with initial pin/credentials: admin@adroit.in / adroit2026), logout button, role badge.

modules.features: Search by client name/phone/service, filter by Status (New, In Review, Contacted, Converted, Closed), assigned partner dropdown, internal notes modal/drawer, audit history timeline, and 'Export to CSV' button [data-testid='export-csv-btn'].
CRUD controls for all 10 service categories and sub-services: toggle visibility (Active/Hidden), reorder items, edit fee guidelines/descriptions, and add custom sub-services.
Update office alert banners, emergency tax compliance notifications, hotline numbers, and firm notice board.
List of staff consultants with access permissions, role assignment (Admin, Partner, Associate), and activity logs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow user choice palette: Navy Blue #10243A, Gold #C6A15B, White #FFFFFF, Light Grey #F3F6F9, Dark Text #243447.
Implement clean, high-prestige typography: Cormorant Garamond for Headings and Outfit for clean legibility.
Never display missing photos or broken image icons for team members. Use stylish circular monograms with CA titles and firm affiliations as requested.
Do not include any Google Map embed on Contact Us page. Deliver a structured, high-polish office coordinate layout instead.
Ensure the Service Accordion has multi-select checkboxes for categories and sub-services with sticky bottom bar for WhatsApp and Clear Selection.
Provide dedicated detail pages for all 10 service categories with rich financial content (What it covers, Who needs it, 5-step process, FAQs, enquiry form).
Admin dashboard must be functional with login, stats overview, interactive enquiry table (search, filter, status change, notes, CSV export), and service management toggle.
Store enquiries and bookings in React state and localStorage so newly submitted forms appear immediately inside the Admin Enquiries table.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
